newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Telecom to sell stake in Korea PC Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Korea Telecom to sell stake in Korea PC Telecom.

text.p: South Korea's state-run Korea Telecom will sell off its stake in Korea PC Telecom Co Ltd by 1998, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Friday.
Korea Telecom holds a 33.5 percent stake in Korea PC Telecom. Neither of the companies is listed on the Korea Stock Exchange.
The ministry said in a statement it would try to sell the stake to small- and mid-sized firms first, but if that fails it would widen the offer.
Korea PC Telecom has a paid-in capital of 20 billion won, it said. The sell-off is part of the government's privatisation programme.
